data.name: Boggy Creek Airboat Ride Adventures & Transport
data.headline: All Ages • Approx. 3 Hours
data.description:
#Boggy Creek Airboat Adventure

##Duration

Approx. 3 Hours

## About This Tour

Discover territory that remains unaltered in the wilderness of the Central Florida Everglades  with a thrilling airboat ride to start your day. View the amazing wildlife Florida has to offer as the wind blows through your hair while you travel up to 40mph.

Experienced captains take you into the breathtaking beauty of nature, including wetlands and wildlife. See alligators, turtles, birds and more in their natural environment.

After your trip, stroll through the Native American Village to learn about how they survived in this beautiful wetland. Towering Chickee’s cover genuine artifacts and hand-made creations of Native Americans. 

Think you can make it as a prospector? Before you leave make sure to try your luck at the gem mining experience. Kids will love it as they sift through sand looking for the perfect stone. 

This is a perfect way to start your morning and be back in time to enjoy whatever you have planned for the rest of the day! 

**Included**
•	30 or 60 min Airboat Tour  
•	Alligator Oasis (Live gator viewing area)
•	Hearing protection and life vests
•	Gem Mine Experience (One per Party)
•	Native American Village  
•	Roundtrip Transportation from International Drive, Disney and Kissimmee areas
•	Professional, Certified and Licensed Tour Guide

**Not Included**
•	Gratuities
•	Drinks
•	Meals


##Pickup Time and Schedule
